Application Deadlines
Important Dates
International applicants must submit ALL required documents by the following deadlines to guarantee consideration for admission:
Spring Semester – October 15
Summer semester – March 15
Fall semester – June 15
For more information about deadlines or application requirements for international applicants, please email international@marshall.edu.
Some graduate programs may have an application deadline that is different than those listed above. For more information about a specific program, please email graduateadmissions@marshall.edu.
Requirements by International Student Type
Jump to Section
Freshman
Transfer
Graduate
Study Abroad
Freshman
Complete Application (Student Type: Freshman)
Official coursework and proof of completion for all secondary school coursework (9th-12th grade) This may include transcripts, marksheets, final exam results, etc. (Must be sent directly to Marshall University from the official issuing source.
Optional Alternative: Official NACES Evaluation or AICE Evaluation of all secondary coursework, if the school is outside the United States
Official United States high school transcripts, if a US school was attended
2.00 Minimum GPA. This will either be present on a United States transcript or will be calculated and converted from coursework taken outside the United States by the Marshall University International Admissions Office.
Official Proof of English Proficiency
Official ACT/SAT scores may be required, depending on your chosen major
If alternate documents are required, they will be listed on your application portal.
All documents must be received directly from the issuing source to be considered official. We may be able to verify some English examinations online once an unofficial copy is received. Please refer to the Official Credential Policy below for more details.
Transfer
Complete Application (Student Type: Transfer)
Official NACES Evaluation or AICE Evaluation of university coursework, if the school is outside the United States
Official United States college transcripts, if a US college was attended
2.00 Minimum GPA. University coursework GPA will be determined by NACES or AICE Evaluation company chosen by the applicant.
Official Proof of English Proficiency
Official ACT/SAT scores may be required, depending on your chosen major
If alternate documents are required, they will be listed on your application portal.
If you have 30 or more earned credit hours at the university level from an accepted, accredited institution, your secondary coursework may not be required. If you have fewer than 30 earned credit hours, you will need to meet the Freshman requirements (see above).
All documents must be received directly from the issuing source to be considered official. We may be able to verify some English examinations online once an unofficial copy is received. Please refer to the Official Credential Policy below for more details.
Graduate
Complete Application (Multiple graduate student options available)
Admission to a graduate program requires a bachelor’s degree from an accepted, accredited institution. Many graduate programs have additional requirements. For information on program-specific requirements, please visit the appropriate section of the Marshall University Graduate Catalog.
After an application is submitted, an applicant will see a list of required materials on the application portal homepage.
Official NACES Evaluation or AICE Evaluation of all required college-level coursework if the school is outside the United States
Official United States college transcripts, if a United States college was attended
Official Proof of English Proficiency
If alternate documents are required, they will be listed on your application portal.
All documents must be received directly from the issuing source to be considered official. We may be able to verify some English examinations online once an unofficial copy is received. Please refer to the Official Credential Policy below for more details.
Study Abroad
Complete Application (Student Type: Transient)
Statement of Good Academic Standing –OR- Official current academic university transcript
Official Proof of English Proficiency
This student type is reserved for existing study abroad exchange programs. For more information, please email our Study Abroad office at studyabroad@marshall.edu.
All documents must be received directly from the issuing source to be considered official. We may be able to verify some English examinations online once an unofficial copy is received. Please refer to the Official Credential Policy below for more details.
Additional Information
How to Apply
Submit the Online Application
Once the application has been submitted, you will be able to view your required documents and how to submit them via the application portal.
If a representative is assisting with the application process, please submit both the Application Cover Sheet and the Student Information Access Form.
Once all required checklist items have been received, you will receive a decision letter via email.
International Application Fee
Currently application fees for degree-seeking programs are waived for international applicants.
If an application fee is required for your chosen program, it will appear on your checklist.
NACES or AICE
Marshall University requires a course-by-course evaluation by a member of either the National Association of Credential Evaluation Services (NACES) or The Association of International Credential Evaluators (AICE) for all post-secondary (college level) academic coursework earned outside the United States. This evaluation must include a CGPA and be based on authenticated/verified documents. A list of accepted evaluation companies is available at naces.org/members for NACES and https://aice-eval.org/endorsed-members/for AICE.
An evaluation may be submitted for secondary coursework but is not required.
Please request the evaluation be sent directly to Marshall University at international@marshall.edu or via the evaluation company’s portal for Marshall University.
For college-level coursework, there is no need to send, or upload additional copies of your credentials, or to have your school send them to Marshall at this time.
Official ACT/SAT Requirements
Can be used to satisfy Proof of English Proficiency. See Proof of English Proficiency page for more information.
Only required for direct entry into some programs, and in certain circumstances. For example: College of Science, College of Engineering and Computer Sciences, Nursing. See the Undergraduate Catalog for more details or email international@marshall.edu.
To have official SAT results sent, contact CollegeBoard at www.collegeboard.org and have them send your official report directly to Marshall University. The Code for Marshall University is #5396.
Official Credential Policy
Official credentials/documents are those received by the Marshall University Office of International Admissions directly from the issuing examination board, credential evaluation company, school, or records office. Student copies of transcripts, evaluations, faxed copies of college transcripts, exams, or credentials issued to any party other than Marshall University are not considered official.
NACES and AICE member credential evaluation reports must be sent to Marshall directly from the evaluation company to be considered official. We have an online portal with many evaluation companies.
Official documents may be emailed to international@marshall.edu from the issuing source.
Please email us is you have any questions!
